verdict.rationale: A live probe found a served llms.txt at rudderstack.com/llms.txt, and docs pages are available as markdown (connect/index.md), so agents can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. The official MCP server can also answer RudderStack feature questions with source citations. The root /docs/.md path returned 404, and the llms.txt content was only seen as a truncated header. missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage (e.g. llms-full.txt or full doc index), consistent markdown availability across docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
